title: Federated LUNG1 radiomics study
text: 1. Connect DataSHIELD nodes. Open one session across three Opal servers register LUNG1 imaging resource. 2. Initialise imaging resource. Bind LUNG1 resource server-side handle confirm CT images GTV-1 masks readable job runs. 3. Extract Aerts radiomics signature. Submit one collection workflow existing tumour masks Aerts profile. dsHPC schedules per-image PyRadiomics jobs site; call returns opaque workflow symbol. 4. Publish load feature table. collection status reports is_done = TRUE, commit completed outputs asset catalogue load — joined clinical metadata — server-side DataSHIELD table. 5. Analyse federated feature table. rad now ordinary server-side DataSHIELD table. Check dimensions, summarise Aerts features fit federated two-year-survival GLM features clinical covariates.
